data.narrative:
X-Bow Systems is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Jason Hundley, Mark Kaufman, and Maureen Gannon, having raised $157M to date. The valuation analysis incorporates a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $157M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implying a valuation of $298M. Peer-median analysis across the 7 same-sector, same-stage private comparables yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The disparity between methods reflects the wide distribution of valuations in this sector at this stage.

Synthesizing both approaches produces a triangulated range of $254M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $649M. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound given the company's recent funding history, while peer benchmarking supports a considerably higher ceiling. Key uncertainties include X-Bow's position within the peer cohort by revenue, technology differentiation, and customer concentration—factors that would justify positioning toward either end of the range.
